text: A nude female with long, flowing red hair lies prone on a glowing circular sigil. Her skin is smooth, pale-toned, and glossy. She wears a blue choker and matching bracelets. Eyes are almond-shaped, lips full and painted red. Body is curvaceous, with prominent hips and rounded shoulders. Hands rest near her head as she gazes upward.
